title: Thinking on Finding your Path, Making a Startup & Walking Away from Academia with Aditi Dimri
summary: Aditi Dimri walks Divya through her path from a microeconomics PhD and World Bank policy work to co-founding Cranberry — a women's health startup in India built around an AI companion called Berry. They unpack why women systematically gaslight themselves about pain, the loss-aversion playbook health marketers use, and what made the iterative startup mode finally feel like the right shape for the work.

intents.display: to hear a founder leave academia and build a women's health startup
